clue.text: Hen-beetle?

definitions.meaning: a hen is a female bird, which a playful reading calls a ...
the small red spotted beetle of gardens

explanation.definitionFit: A female bird can be jokingly called a lady bird, and the spotted garden insect carries the same name as one word.

clue.text: Alliance that gives the French the shivers?

parts.note: le is French for the
ague is a fever with fits of shivering

explanation.surface: A partnership that makes the French tremble.
explanation.definitionFit: A league is a union of parties for a common purpose, an alliance.

clue.text: Wet earth repeatedly thrown up by this bullet

indicators.note: repeatedly calls for the reversed piece to appear twice in a row
in a down clue thrown up means read upwards, so the word is backwards

parts.note: wet earth is mud

explanation.surface: A bullet spattering mud again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown up' turns MUD into DUM and 'repeatedly' doubles it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dumdum is a soft-nosed bullet that expands on impact.

clue.text: Agitated couple-butt of joke -flushed

parts.note: a couple of things are both of them

indicators.note: the butt of something is its end, so the last letter of joke is taken

parts.note: flushed in the face is red

explanation.surface: A pair, the target of a joke, go red with annoyance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butt of joke' looks like the victim of a prank; it is the final letter, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Bothered means troubled or flustered, agitated.

clue.text: Unusual gunman about

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners, so a gunman
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A rare sight: a gunman standing about.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare means seldom found, uncommon.

clue.text: Scholar's got a crib -—- lucky for him!

parts.note: an MA is a Master of Arts, a scholar, so the possessive gives MA'S
a crib is a child's bed, a cot

explanation.surface: A student gets himself a bed and counts himself fortunate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lucky for him!' defines a thing kept to bring luck; 'got a' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A mascot is a person, animal or object kept as a charm to bring good luck.

clue.text: Boy to join one of the Furies

parts.note: Alec is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad teams up with an avenging goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Alecto is one of the three Erinyes, the avenging Furies.

clue.text: A fancy twist to lock — first insert copper key

parts.note: a lock of hair is a curl

indicators.note: the first letter of the word insert is taken

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Instructions for working a lock: put the copper key in first and give it a turn.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads like opening a door; 'key' is the musical key E.
explanation.definitionFit: A curlicue is a decorative curl or flourish, a fancy twist in a design.

clue.text: More than one possibility of getting there, travelling by this method

definitions.text: More than one possibility of getting there, travelling by this method

parts.words: More than one possibility of getting there, travelling by this method
parts.note: describes a junction or arrangement offering several routes, an option count above two, as if a means of travel

explanation.surface: A route-planner offering several ways to reach the destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Three-way describes something with three directions or options, more than one way of getting there.

clue.text: Keeper taking up gun for a true sport

parts.note: a gun is a firearm, an arm

indicators.note: to sport is to play about, so the letters of 'a true' are played with and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone picks up a gun for some honest shooting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sport' rearranges A TRUE into ATURE. A keeper is the bar of soft iron laid across a magnet's poles, also called an armature.
explanation.definitionFit: In magnetism the soft iron bar placed across a magnet's poles to preserve it is called both a keeper and an armature.

clue.text: Dread making the first mistake

indicators.note: the first letter of the word 'the' is taken, here its opening letter

parts.note: a mistake is an error

explanation.surface: Fear comes from getting off on the wrong foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Dread and terror are both words for intense fear.

clue.text: One of the black and white minstrels?

definitions.text: One of the black and white minstrels?

parts.words: One of the black and white minstrels?
parts.note: a musician who plays the black and white keys of an instrument, punning on a once-famous British variety troupe

explanation.surface: A member of a well-known old TV singing troupe.
explanation.walkthrough: The Black and White Minstrels were a British TV variety troupe; here the black and white are a keyboard's keys.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard player performs on black and white keys, so he is a minstrel of the black and white.

clue.text: Not accustomed to seeing an international body exploited

parts.note: the United Nations, the UN, is an international body
exploited means used

explanation.surface: Someone is unfamiliar with watching a world organisation being taken advantage of.
explanation.definitionFit: Unused to something means unfamiliar with it or not in the habit of it.

clue.text: Clan at first rejecting assistance with invective

indicators.note: says the reversed assistance comes before the clan word in the answer
rejecting sends the word back, so the synonym for assistance is read from its end

parts.note: assistance is aid
a clan is a tribe

explanation.surface: A clan turns down help and responds with abuse.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a bitter verbal attack, a burst of invective.

clue.text: And, getting lost, lodging for a day in France hence delay

indicators.note: lodging means giving room to, so the scrambled word takes the French day inside
getting lost means the letters of and wander out of order

parts.note: jour is French for day

explanation.surface: Someone loses their way and stays a day in France, causing a delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting lost' rearranges AND into ADN; 'lodging' puts JOUR inside it, between D and N.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjourn is to postpone or suspend proceedings, to put off to later.

clue.text: Locked up desperate character inside — a hanging matter

indicators.note: puts the character within the word for locked up

parts.note: locked up means pent, as in pent-up
Desperate Dan is the strongman of the British comic The Dandy

explanation.surface: A violent criminal is jailed; his crime was a capital one.
explanation.walkthrough: Desperate Dan is a long-running British comic-strip hero from The Dandy. 'a hanging matter' suggests the gallows but means a piece of jewellery that hangs.
explanation.definitionFit: A pendant is an ornament hung from a chain round the neck, so it is something that hangs.

clue.text: Music-maker takes a bath first

indicators.note: says the bath word stands first, before the A, in the answer

parts.note: a bath is a tub

explanation.surface: A musician has a bath before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuba is a large brass instrument, so it is a maker of music.

clue.text: Excess of petrol has mostly dispersed

indicators.note: dispersed means the letters are scattered and regathered in a new order
mostly means most of the word has, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: Too much fuel has largely evaporated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts HAS to HA; 'dispersed' rearranges PETROL plus HA.
explanation.definitionFit: A plethora is an overabundance, too much of something.

clue.text: Incentive for second union uprising

parts.note: a second is a moment

indicators.note: in a down clue an uprising reads upwards, so the union's letters are reversed

parts.note: MU is the Musicians' Union

explanation.surface: A trade union rises up in support of a motive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns MU into UM. The MU is the Musicians' Union, a British trade union.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentum is driving force or impetus, the push that keeps things moving, like an incentive.

clue.text: Those who have a taste for needlework?

definitions.meaning: people who try a little of something to judge it
embroidered panels showing stitches, made as a display of skill

explanation.definitionFit: Tasters who try a bit of food are samplers, and embroidered show pieces of stitching are also samplers.

clue.text: Appear to see instant repulsion

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning see or behold

indicators.note: repulsion pushes back, so the short word for an instant is turned round

parts.note: a mo is a moment, an instant

explanation.surface: Someone is about to witness an immediate rejection.
explanation.definitionFit: To loom is to come into view, appearing large or threatening.

clue.text: Takes a shot at sheep, in Germany

parts.note: to pot is to shoot at game, so pots means takes a shot at
a dam is a mother animal, here a ewe

explanation.surface: A hunter fires at sheep while in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place in Germany; 'sheep' gives DAM, the word for a mother animal such as a ewe.
explanation.definitionFit: Potsdam is a city near Berlin, the capital of Brandenburg, so it is found in Germany.

clue.text: Like a hundred and ten, maybe, getting a rise

parts.note: as means like, in the way of
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: maybe suggests the word ten is one possible arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: Something like 110 percent, an increase.
explanation.definitionFit: An ascent is a climb or upward movement, a rise.

clue.text: Composed most of the andantes

definitions.meaning: andante movements are mostly unhurried and stately in pace

explanation.walkthrough: 'Composed' looks like a word about music being written, but means calm; the second definition is whimsical, since most andante movements are dignified and slow.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm, collected people are sedate, and pieces at a gentle walking pace are mostly sedate too.

clue.text: Little ball the French hide outside

indicators.note: the hide goes outside, wrapping the French article

parts.note: a hide is an animal skin, a pelt
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A small ball the French keep hidden outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A pellet is a small rounded mass, a tiny ball of shot or paper.

clue.text: Tear-jerking, and it can be counted upon to be of value

indicators.note: jerking jolts the letters of the word tear out of order

parts.note: something sure is reliable, able to be counted upon

explanation.surface: A weepie, yet something you can rely on to be worthwhile.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jerking' rearranges TEAR into TREA; 'and it' and 'to be of' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: To treasure something is to prize it, to value it highly.

clue.text: After thought, returning to this place and finding ball

indicators.note: returning brings the letters back, read from the end

parts.note: a PS, postscript, is an afterthought added to a letter
this place is here

explanation.surface: Having reconsidered, someone comes back here and finds a ball.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere is a round solid shape, a globe or ball.

clue.text: Do nothing right? Expect to be shown this!

parts.note: taken as written
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: If you can't do anything correctly, expect to be thrown out.
explanation.walkthrough: To be shown the door is to be dismissed, which is what awaits someone who does nothing right.
explanation.definitionFit: Being shown the exit, an idiom for dismissal, means being pointed to the way out of a room.

clue.text: Dismissed by firm at beginning

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out
firm, fixed, means set

explanation.surface: Someone sacked by a company right at the start of the job.
explanation.definitionFit: The outset is the start or beginning of something.

clue.text: Joint damaged -violated

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of violated are broken and reassembled

explanation.surface: A joint has been harmed and abused.
explanation.definitionFit: A dovetail is an interlocking woodworking joint of fan-shaped tenons.

clue.text: Amidst confusion, doesn't keep us out

indicators.note: confusion means the letters of amidst are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: In the chaos, the doorkeeper lets us in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who admits people lets them enter rather than excluding them.

clue.text: What yield can we hope for, from crop pest devastated?

definitions.text: What yield can we hope for

indicators.note: devastated means the letters of crop pest are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A farmer wonders what harvest is likely after pests ravaged the crop.
explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is an expectation or outlook, what one may hope to gain.
